verdict.rationale: Decagon's security page says its agents use short-lived JWT tokens scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session, and its MCP blog stresses scoping tool access. This shows a least-privilege credential model for agent access to customer systems, but nothing shows users can issue or configure those scopes themselves. Missing for 10: user-facing credential issuance or API key management, documentation of configurable scopes or permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
